title: Quantum circuit compilation benchmark experiments
question: How do circuit structure and compilation settings affect computational cost or output quality?
publisher: Zenodo; originating researchers: IBM Quantum; Nation, Paul (IBM Research)
measurement_dates: 2025-03-06 deposit; benchmark JSON datetime fields record individual computational executions (including 2024), distinct from release date.
variables_and_units: Variables and units are preserved in native column headers, instrument metadata and source dictionaries; see evidence anchors below.
independent_units: Circuit family and complete compiler/run configurations.
validation_design: Circuit family and complete compiler/run configurations. Verify identifiers before allocating groups; the partition is not executed or frozen by this acquisition.
author_preprocessing: Computational timing/compilation experiments summarized by the source benchmarking harness; repeated timings and failures are retained. No quantum hardware shots are claimed.
prior_analysis_and_limits: Benchpress 1.0 results were used in a Nature Computational Science publication. Circuit inputs and full compiler environments are not bundled in this result archive; commit/environment metadata is retained for reconstruction. Timing variation depends on hardware and software versions. IBM Benchpress computational benchmarks; keep failures/timeouts and avoid selecting only successful circuits.
missingness: Native blanks, sentinels, absent records and source quality flags are preserved. No imputation performed by the curator. Exact missingness semantics come from source dictionaries/headers; no universal missing-value rule is imposed.
calibration: Use the retained source calibration files/standards and instrument metadata where provided. Absence of an explicit calibration record is not replaced by an assumed calibration.

eligibility.novelty: no unseen-law guarantee; independent adjudication required

exposure: Open source-aware; source literature and supplied analyses accessible
unit_interpretation: Use exact source field/sheet/channel labels and units in source_evidence and per-file reports; unknown units remain unresolved, not inferred from a variable name.
